exposure: exclusive breastfeeding for at least 1 month
cohort: 123 women with endometriosis who breastfed, out of 156 pregnant women with endometriosis enrolled
finding: Breastfeeding, particularly if exclusive, may cause improvement in dysmenorrhea and CPP proportional to the duration of breastfeeding, as well as a reduction in the size of ovarian endometriomas.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was analysed but no findings related to mode of delivery were reported.
